name: Can I add a recessed shower niche if my bathroom walls are very thin?

mainEntity.name: Can I add a recessed shower niche if my bathroom walls are very thin?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Recessed niches can add useful storage without taking floor space, but they require careful placement and waterproofing when installed in a shower wall. A niche may conflict with plumbing, wiring, framing, exterior walls, or the preferred tile layout.

Elite Remodeling & Design can include storage in the layout and design-development stage, when wall conditions and tile alignment can still be reviewed. In some rooms, a surface-mounted cabinet or corner shelf may be a simpler alternative.

Key factors:
- Available wall cavity
- Plumbing and electrical conflicts
- Waterproofing at the niche
- Product sizes and bottle height

List the items you actually store before choosing shelf dimensions. Ask where the niche will sit relative to the shower controls, spray, corners, and grout pattern.
acceptedAnswer.description: Possibly, but the wall cavity, framing, plumbing, wiring, exterior-wall conditions, and waterproofing determine whether it is practical. If a recessed niche creates conflicts, compare a surface cabinet or corner shelf instead of forcing storage into an unsuitable wall.
